new_workspace: Head-to-head matchup DNA — the matchday to play with its HT/FT card and the 1ST/2ND/EQUAL half call underneath it, the season's frozen calls under every recorded score, and a historical analysis of any team pair across the archive
research_scope: Walk-forward prediction of the highest scoring half (1st half / 2nd half / equal) for the matchday set to play, from the recorded meetings of that exact fixture; every sheet is frozen when the matchday is announced and graded against published HT/FT

candidate_engines: h2h (head-to-head & venue) — measured leave-one-out, did not improve the mixture, held back
playground.ledger: data/predictions.sqlite — one sheet per matchday: locked once when the matchday is announced, never rewritten; grading fills result columns only; source live|backfill
playground.board_rows: Recorded FT score on top, the frozen walk-forward prediction for the same matchday underneath
playground.live_refresh: client beats /api/playground/tick every 4 s (~2 ms) and pulls the full payload only when board_key moves; the service syncs the ledger every 5 s and rebuilds the report in the background (throttled to 240 s)
playground.freeze_proof: live sheets locked up to 206 s before kick-off; the browser checker reloads the page and compares the season-keyed pick|verdict cells of every played matchday
playground.colours: green = exact FT, amber = right result, red = wrong, purple = to play

measures.note: read the live figures from /api/health and the workspace; the report is refitted as the archive grows

prediction_ledger: data/predictions.sqlite (frozen sheets, locked once and never overwritten)

matchups.page: /matchups (also the Head-to-head matchup DNA navigation entry)
matchups.ledger: data/predictions.sqlite — half_sheets/half_picks: a sheet is locked when the matchday is announced, grading only ever fills result columns
matchups.call: highest scoring half — 1H = ht_home+ht_away, 2H = (ft_home-ht_home)+(ft_away-ht_away), EQ = tie
matchups.probability: Jeffreys-smoothed three-way share of that exact fixture's recorded meetings
matchups.sub_workspace: Historical analysis tab — team-pair dropdown over every archived pair, venue scope, every recorded meeting with HT, FT, both halves and the half that won
matchups.live_refresh: client beats /api/matchups/tick every 4 s and pulls the board only when board_key moves
matchups.colours: green = the half call was right, red = wrong, purple = still to play, grey = no card

collector.gaps: the history worker fills published-but-missing matchdays first, current season first and newest day first, then walks season ids in likelihood order and finishes with an exhaustive sweep
collector.discovery: backend/discovery.py — SeasonScanner (walk pass then sweep pass, one probe per request)
collector.fairness: backend/source.py — reserved-share lane scheduler (archive lane 0.55 of the last 12 slots)
collector.storage: wal_autocheckpoint=256 and journal_size_limit=4 MB so side files stay inside the workspace budget

packages.note: the sha256 of each published archive is recorded in RELEASES.md and in the release.json that sits next to the archives, not here
packages.self_reference: this file is inside the archive, so it cannot carry its own hash
